title: Terra Exploration Group survey finds tunnel from Secret Mountain to Clarkdale Cement Plant
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Terra Exploration Group survey finds tunnel from Secret Mountain to Clarkdale Cement Plant, about an unknown time at Secret Mountain to Bradshaw Ranch to Clarkdale Cement Plant, Arizona, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Secret Mountain to Bradshaw Ranch to Clarkdale Cement Plant, Arizona

tellings.quote: A tunnel. Geophysical surveys and magnetometry by Terra Exploration Group showed a straight, man-made tunnel, roughly 50 ft in diameter, running like a hidden artery from Secret Mountain to Bradshaw Ranch to the front gate of the Clarkdale Cement Plant, which John Bradshaw claims used to be the biggest employer in town, and was guarded and [music] fenced like a military site.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that underground surveys by a company called Terra Exploration Group, using magnetic sensing, showed a straight man-made tunnel about 50 feet wide in Arizona. According to Michels, it runs from a peak called Secret Mountain past Bradshaw Ranch to the front gate of the Clarkdale Cement Plant, which the ranch's John Bradshaw says was once the town's biggest employer and was fenced and guarded like a military site. If true, it would point to a hidden underground facility in the area.
